reviews.title: Awesome mb+cpu+memory combo
reviews.comment: Great startup combo for those who want to build a mid-level gaming PC with little research.  The price was just right and my son loves the performance.  I've been a fan of Newegg for many years, probably have spent thousands of dollars in parts, so I trust them as sellers.  This kit takes the guessing out having to pair the 3 main components of any build.
reviews.author: Elias

reviews.title: MB was defective
reviews.comment: Either this was a board that was damaged by a previous customer, was returned and wasn't checked out properly by Micro Center; or it was brand new but got past MSI quality control. I wasted a couple of hours installing the board only to find the onboard LEDs indicated the processor wasn't working. Upon examination of the CPU socket I noticed two contacts that looked odd. I took a picture. On magnifying it I saw that the contacts were bent.
reviews.author: Brent

reviews.title: Im happy with the combo.
reviews.comment: The kit worked great. Im still fiddling with the small details like some drivers. But its working great.
